recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding one independent missing-success alarm outside the script that notifies the user if no success is reported by morning, and nothing else.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know within a day when nightly-sync fails without reading logs; you suggested a central log on the NAS and Docker.
labels.Deleted: central log, Docker rollout, Pieter Levels style setup, because none of it pushes an alert and none would have fired on a pre-email crash.
labels.Bottleneck: failure is silent when the script dies before its summary email or never starts, so you only find out by accident days later.
labels.Checked myself: You told me nightly-sync runs by cron at 03:00 on edna, emails on finish, died 4 nights on expired token before email, with no other alert.

note: The reply recommends one dead-man alarm and drops the central log and Docker; its 'within a day' requirement is the agent's own reading, not something the user said.
